title: Persistent bottom buy CTA wired to existing UPI flow

requirements.summary: Add a sticky/fixed bottom buy bar on the landing page that stays visible while scrolling and triggers the existing UPI payment flow without obscuring content.
acceptanceCriteria: When scrolling anywhere on the landing page, a bottom “buy” CTA remains visible at the bottom of the screen.
Clicking/tapping the bottom CTA triggers the same payment behavior as the existing hero CTAs (calls `initiatePayment` from `useUpiPayment(...)` and shows the existing fallback dialog when needed).

On both mobile and desktop viewports, the persistent bottom bar does not cover/obstruct the page’s content; the user can still access the footer and last section content without it being hidden behind the bar.
All text shown in the bottom CTA/bar is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable persistent bottom CTA bar component rendered as a fixed/sticky bottom container with an English “Buy/Unlock” call-to-action. Use the shadcn-ui Button component to keep styling consistent and support accessible interaction. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render the new PersistentBottomCtaBar on the landing page and wire its onClick to the existing `initiatePayment` returned by `useUpiPayment(upiPaymentLink)` (matching hero CTA behavior, including existing deep-link + fallback dialog). Add appropriate bottom spacing to the landing page content so the final sections/footer remain visible and tappable above the fixed bar across mobile and desktop. Ensure all new visible strings in the bar are in English.

Add a small global utility (or CSS variable) to support safe bottom spacing for fixed bottom UI (including mobile safe-area inset) so the landing page can add reliable bottom padding/margin that prevents the persistent bar from covering the last content.
